Quarterback situations

TeamSituation
ALAKeelon Russell rested his ankle against Chattanooga, was left off the first SEC availability report for Auburn, and DeBoer said Nov 23 he expects him 'full-go' all week (Yahoo Sports, Nov 23). Picked over Austin Mack, who only started the Chattanooga game; high confidence, though DeBoer has not formally named him.
AUBUnconfirmed. Byrum Brown, who has started every game, is listed questionable on the first SEC availability report (247Sports; TD Alabama Mag, Nov 25), and Tristan Ti'a would likely start if he cannot go. Ti'a stays modeled, but Brown starting is roughly a coin flip and would be a stronger passer profile.
TCUJaden Craig (ankle) is out on Wednesday's Big 12 report and Adam Schobel makes his second straight start at Texas Tech under interim coach Andy Avalos (Heartland College Sports, Nov 26). High confidence; Schobel's sample is one game.
TTUThomas Castellanos is named Texas Tech's starter in game-day previews and is not on Wednesday's Big 12 out list (Heartland College Sports, Nov 26). High confidence.
SYRFran Brown said Monday that Steve Angeli (shoulder AC joint) will not play and Malachi Nelson makes his third start of the season (Yahoo/Nunes Magician, Nov 23). High confidence.
NDCJ Carr is Notre Dame's starter in this week's previews for Syracuse (UHND, Nov 25) with no injury reported. The QB listed out is a backup. High confidence.
OSUJulian Sayin (elbow) remains out and Luke Fahey starts against Michigan per this week's previews (Yahoo preview, week of Nov 23). High confidence.
CLEMTait Reynolds is out for the season and Christopher Vizzina is in concussion protocol, so Trent Pearman starts against South Carolina (Greenville News via Yahoo, Nov 26). High confidence.
SCBeamer said LaNorris Sellers is still managing an ankle injury but feels good after returning against Georgia, and previews have him playing at Clemson (On3/247Sports, week of Nov 23). Medium-high confidence; no official report seen.
WISFickell said Nov 23 that Colton Joseph 'has earned the right' but made no declaration; On3's Badger Blitz reports Joseph is expected to start against Minnesota (date not verified, this week). Medium-high confidence; Ryan Hopkins is back at practice after concussion protocol.
TA&MUnconfirmed. Mike Elko said this week he is 'not sure yet' between Brady Hart and Marcel Reed for Texas (Houston Chronicle; KBTX, Nov 24). Hart stays modeled; Reed starting is a real possibility.
MSSTAJ Swann is doubtful on the first SEC availability report and Parker (Billy) Puckett is the expected starter at Ole Miss, with Brodie McWhorter possibly playing (SI/Yahoo, this week). Lebby has not named a starter, so medium confidence.
UNCUnconfirmed. Belichick has not named a starter for NC State; Billy Edwards Jr. is off the injury report and warmed up last week, while Travis Burgess started at Virginia (Chatham Journal, Nov 25; Tar Heel Tribune, Nov 23). Burgess stays modeled; Edwards starting is a real possibility.
NUAidan Chiles is still out (week to week) and Nicco Marchiol has started the last three games (Covers; Yahoo Week 13 preview). No formal announcement for Illinois, so medium-high confidence.
KSUUnconfirmed. Dillon Duff is questionable (day to day) on the Big 12 report after a hit at Arizona; Klein said 'We'll see' and that Blake Barnett 'will be ready' if Duff cannot go (KMAN, Nov 24; Rotowire; Yahoo). Duff stays modeled; Barnett starting is a real possibility.
UCLAUnconfirmed. Ty Dieffenbach (hip/leg) is questionable on the Nov 25 Big Ten report and attended practice, but one report calls him unlikely to play; Madden Iamaleava took first-team reps and would likely start (UCLA Wire via Yahoo, Nov 26). Dieffenbach stays modeled; low confidence.
MSUAlessio Milivojevic (left arm) is out and Cam Fancher (knee) is questionable on the Big Ten report, so Kayd Coffman is likely to start again at Rutgers (Yahoo preview; Rotowire, this week). Medium-high confidence.
KUIsaiah Marshall is the starter in this week's Oklahoma State previews and has been managing a lower-leg injury (BVM Sports, Nov 25). The questionable QB on the feed is a backup. Medium-high confidence.
IUUnconfirmed. Cignetti said Nov 23-24 he will not name a starter for Purdue and both Josh Hoover and Grant Wilson are working with the first team. Wilson stays modeled; Hoover starting is a real possibility.
PITTUnconfirmed. Holden Geriner was benched for Corey Dailey in the 42-10 loss at Louisville and no starter has been named for Cal (SI, Nov 22). Geriner stays modeled; Dailey starting is a real possibility.
ASUDillingham said 'right now you gotta say it's Jake Fette' while Mikey Keene (knee) works his way back (Arizona Desert Swarm/Yahoo, this week). Medium-high confidence.
HOUUnconfirmed. Conner Weigman (right shoulder) is questionable on the Big 12 report and practiced this week; Fritz said the call should come Thursday or Friday (Houston Chronicle; Rotowire, Nov 25). Keisean Henderson stays modeled; Weigman starting is a real possibility.

Starters on other teams come from the latest game played, skipping anyone listed out, not a confirmed announcement.

Player probabilities are close to honest. Holdout buckets landed within about 3 points of actual hit rates, except the top two, which ran 4 points high. Those high numbers now take a haircut, fit on the same holdout, so that correction has not been tested on new games.

Game lines show no edge. Spread MAE was 11.84 points for the close vs 13.06 for our line. Total MAE was 12.73 vs 13.26, across 291 games. The best-fit weight on our line was negative, so every game side here is a pass.

Prop value is unknown. No college prop lines were available, so no prop EV is claimed. The small sample covers six weeks of one season.

2026 holdout, all markets. Dots near the dashed line mean a forecast of X% hit about X% of the time.

Data gaps

  • Prop lines and prices: none found. Each game gives fair lines and limits instead. Moneyline, spread and total prices are real DraftKings numbers via ESPN.
  • Scheme: no man/zone, coverage shell, blitz or pressure rate, routes, alignment or snap counts exist in free college data. Throw location appears only in games with charted text. Nothing here is inferred from a coach's reputation.
  • Positions: roles come from usage, so tight ends show as WR.
  • Injuries: college has no required injury report. Covers is unofficial, and P(plays) values are assumptions. In the backtest 35% of eligible players did not log a stat, so absences are a large risk.
  • Sample: 2026 only for market-tied testing, because ESPN holds few 2025 lines.

Sources: ESPN, NWS, Covers injuries.

These are estimates, and no selection is guaranteed. After the games, run review_cfb.py to score every forecast (Phase 15).

Aggressive: Cooper Barkate 50+ receiving yds (61%) + Vandrevius Jacobs 30+ receiving yds (60%) + Javarius Green 20+ receiving yds (58%). Joint estimate 21.7%, fair +361. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 13.2% vs 13.0% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Lee Beebe Jr. 60+ rushing yds (58%) + Charlie Becker 60+ receiving yds (57%) + Brandon Kinsey 20+ receiving yds (56%). Joint estimate 19.2%, fair +421. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 13.6% vs 13.2% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Balanced: Chris Lawson 30+ receiving yds (79%) + Dakorien Moore 20+ receiving yds (79%) + Demond Williams Jr. 150+ passing yds (77%). Joint estimate 52.4%, fair -110. These legs are positively correlated: sim joint 47.1% vs 43.0% if independent. Not guaranteed.

Aggressive: Chris Lawson 50+ receiving yds (62%) + Rashid Williams 20+ receiving yds (60%) + Dakorien Moore 40+ receiving yds (59%). Joint estimate 22.3%, fair +349. These legs are approximately independent: sim joint 13.6% vs 13.4% if independent. Not guaranteed.
